/**
 * Converts the first character of string to lower case.
 *
 * @param str - The string that is to be changed
 * @returns The converted string.
 *
 * @example
 * const convertedStr1 = lowerFirst('fred') // returns 'fred'
 * const convertedStr2 = lowerFirst('Fred') // returns 'fred'
 * const convertedStr3 = lowerFirst('FRED') // returns 'fRED'
 */

contract.method: source-reviewed curated specification; not automatic extraction
contract.description: Return the input string with only its first character converted to lower case using Unicode casing. Leave the remainder exactly unchanged; the first character may expand to multiple characters. Return the empty string for empty input.
contract.domain: Text contains only BMP characters and no UTF-16 surrogate code units. Text length is at most 128 characters.
contract.outputRole: text with only its first character lowercased
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
